SPARK deep-research synthesis follow-up. Parent: task_2026-08-21_001 (all 19 child tracks done + merged). Same two-phase pattern as the portfolio-site analysis (task_2026-08-14_001→010): the 19 parallel tracks gathered evidence, this single task synthesizes it into the 3 deliverables the parent spec named — narrowed Claim 1 & 3 thesis wording, a completed DATA_COLLECTION_PROTOCOL.md, and updated Ch.6 future-work draft text.

Source of truth: dev_logs/SPARK_TRACKER.md v54, github.com/AaradhyaDT/SPARK main @ 53f194de7cd0679c866d905275b465f80c0d9bfb. Full per-track checkpoints: /mnt/user-data/outputs/SPARK_research_board_merged.md. Digest anchor: nlm note_id 3cafb3af-5969-48e1-8b5a-01fd86126573 in notebook 95a79d26-2f87-42cd-8cb9-8361a1e56059 ("SPARK deep-research board — 19-track merge (2026-08-22)").

Deliverable 1 — Narrowed novelty claims (Action #26, §2.3): Draft final Claim 1 and Claim 3 thesis sentences using Track 1's and Track 2's proposed narrowed wording as the starting point, cross-checked against Track 3's finding that Claim 4's broader "adjustable threshold" framing needs a caution note (not a rewrite) since real prior art exists there.

Deliverable 2 — Completed data-collection protocol (Action #23, docs/DATA_COLLECTION_PROTOCOL.md): Integrate Track 7's drafted F09-F15/D15-D19 rows into the doc's existing table format, respecting Track 7's own flagged exclusion (SisFall F07, table-assisted fall, safety grounds) and its 2 judgment-call ADL slots. Fold in Track 8's protocol-adjustment recommendation (Klenk-style "act frail" instruction) and Track 9's N=12-20 subject-count recommendation, both explicitly flagged as precedent-based inputs to the still-pending HOD conversation, not settled figures.

Deliverable 3 — Updated Ch.6 future-work draft: Synthesize Tracks 13 (camera fusion), 14 (cloud archival), 15 (aquatic distress) into draft text, preserving each track's population-mismatch/unvalidated-parameter caveats rather than smoothing them over (Track 15 in particular: IDR struggle index >2.5Hz has no traceable numeric source and must be presented as an engineering assumption, not a validated figure).

Also surface, don't resolve — these need Aaradhya/Rupesh's direct decision, not synthesis: Track 12's open BLE-notify-frequency question (continuous 200Hz vs trigger-only) that determines which end of the 90-130mA vs 35-60mA R-05 range applies; Track 10's self-tapping-vs-heat-set-insert fastener question for Action #39; Track 8's real-elderly supplementary-cohort feasibility call.

This is drafting/research output only, matching every one of the 19 tracks' own boundary — no SPARK source code changes, no SPARK_TRACKER.md edits, no repo edits, no sync.ps1 invocation, no commits. Deliver via submit_checkpoint result_text as three clearly-separated drafts (one per deliverable above) for Aaradhya to review and apply himself.
